# Isaiah Chapter 7 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 145r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/ISA_007_page_001.jpg

---

**7:14** Therefore the-Lord himself will-give [yitten] to-you a-sign [ot]: Behold, the-young-woman [ha-almah] [is] pregnant [harah] and-bearing [veyoledet] a-son [ben], and-she-will-call [veqarat] his-name Immanu-El [God-With-Us].

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.14 — "the young woman":** *Ha-almah* — "the young woman" (a specific woman known to Ahaz). The LXX translated this as *parthenos* ("virgin"), which became the basis for Matthew 1:23. In context, the sign is the timing: before this child knows good from evil, the two enemy kings will be gone. The identity of the *almah* is debated — Isaiah's wife? A woman in Ahaz's court?

*— EMET*
